head: codex/510-hot-01-axum-config-hot-reload
title: [v0.92.1][HOT-01] Add runtime config hot reload
body:
## Summary
- Add atomic, debounced Runtime configuration hot reload with last-known-good retention and clean shutdown.
- Wire accepted RuntimeInitConfig origin updates into the production Observatory authority used by HTTP CORS and authenticated WSS.
- Support immediate revocation to an empty origin set, consistent initial application, and single-read snapshot parsing.

## Validation
- adl-runtime config_reload integration: 8 passed
- adl-runtime-kernel live Observatory origin-policy integration: passed
- adl-runtime-kernel production binary cargo check: passed
- git diff --check: passed

## Review
- Independent GPT-5.6 Sol API review found and verified fixes for production wiring, same-snapshot parsing, debounce cancellation, startup consistency, read-failure handling, and empty-origin revocation.
- Final exact scoped review: PASS with no findings.

Closes #510
